_comment_purpose: ISH-09 (customer-provisioning-orchestration-r1 Wave 5 punchlist, 2026-08-27). Prod-environment companion of context-defaults.dev.json — the token map is identical in SHAPE (same 20 tokens sourced the same way); only the SOURCE VALUES differ per env. This file exists so a prod-only substitution regression is easy to spot in diff review, and so validate.ps1 can cross-check both dev + prod against prereqs.yaml without treating dev as canonical.
_comment_authority: spaarke-constants.yaml + SKILL.md Step 0.5b are the RUNTIME authorities — the skill actually reads those. This file is DOCUMENTATION-ONLY.

customerId.shape: customerId standard ^[a-z][a-z0-9]{2,7}$ (3-8 lowercase letters/digits, starts with a letter; AZURE-RESOURCE-NAMING-CONVENTION.md)

env.populatedBy: intake.schema.json controlPlaneEnv property (ISH-12 SESSION 18 rename from `environment` → `controlPlaneEnv`)

region.populatedBy: intake.schema.json region property; aliased to openAiRegion in Step 0.5b

subId.populatedBy: az account show --query id -o tsv (prod subscription context)

l2UamiPrincipalId.populatedBy: az identity show -g rg-spaarke-platform-prod -n sprk-controlplane-prod-uami --query principalId

l2UamiSpId.populatedBy: az ad sp show --id {l2UamiClientId} --query id -o tsv

graphAppId.shape: Fixed Microsoft Graph appId (invariant across envs)

customerManagementGroupId.shape: Management-group id (name): spaarke-customers (tenant-wide, invariant across envs)

artifactsStorageId.populatedBy: az storage account show -g rg-spaarke-platform-prod -n sprkprodartifacts --query id -o tsv

acrId.populatedBy: az acr show -g rg-spaarke-platform-prod -n sprkprodacr --query id -o tsv

kvResourceId.populatedBy: az keyvault show -g rg-spaarke-platform-prod -n sprk-prod-kv --query id -o tsv

dvUrl.populatedBy: intake dataverseEnvUrl — the environment the operator created (PRQ-C-09), canonical https://{host}/ with a trailing slash (T228)

adminDvUrl.populatedBy: spaarke-constants.yaml name_templates.registryDvUrl.prod (currently placeholder — not yet provisioned)

stampSubscriptionId.shape: Azure subscription GUID — the customer stamp's own subscription
stampSubscriptionId.populatedBy: intake.schema.json subscriptionId (ADR-027: one subscription per customer)
stampSubscriptionId.note: Used by PRQ-S-00 / PRQ-S-04 and PRQ-E-05 (once_per_customer) — substituted by the skill's customer pass (Step 1e-ter).

stampEnvironment.shape: dev | staging | prod — the customer stamp's environment segment (customer.bicep environmentName)
stampEnvironment.note: Distinct from {env} (the L2 control-plane tier). Used by PRQ-E-05 — the customer pass (Step 1e-ter) substitutes L2's default 'prod'; the intake has no override.

environmentSecurityGroupId.shape: Object id (GUID) of the security group sprk-{customerId}-users
environmentSecurityGroupId.populatedBy: intake.schema.json environmentSecurityGroupId property (skill Step 1e-bis); the operator creates the group and sets it on the environment (PRQ-C-10)
environmentSecurityGroupId.note: PRQ-C-10 is once_per_customer — run by the skill's customer pass (Step 1e-ter). Required for B2BGuest (every Model 1 run).

exchangePolicyScopeGroupId.shape: Email address or object id of a mail-enabled security group
exchangePolicyScopeGroupId.populatedBy: intake.schema.json exchangePolicyScopeGroupId property (skill Step 1e-bis); the group is created by the stamp tenant's Exchange admin (PRQ-C-08)
exchangePolicyScopeGroupId.note: PRQ-C-08 is once_per_customer — run by the skill's customer pass (Step 1e-ter).

customerWorkforceTenantIds.shape: Space-separated Entra tenant ids (GUIDs) — the intake array customerWorkforceTenantIds joined with spaces
customerWorkforceTenantIds.populatedBy: intake.schema.json customerWorkforceTenantIds property (skill Step 1e-bis); the customer's IT gives the tenant id(s) (PRQ-C-13)
customerWorkforceTenantIds.note: PRQ-C-13 is once_per_customer — run by the skill's customer pass (Step 1e-ter). Required for every run (T255, INCOMING-141).

customerOutboundB2BAttested.shape: true | notApplicable — `true` only when the customer's Entra admin has confirmed outbound B2B collaboration to Spaarke's tenant; `notApplicable` for a run that is not B2BGuest; anything else (false, absent) fails the check
customerOutboundB2BAttested.populatedBy: intake.schema.json customerOutboundB2BAttested property (skill Step 1e-bis); the skill maps a non-B2BGuest run to notApplicable (PRQ-C-14)
customerOutboundB2BAttested.note: PRQ-C-14 is once_per_customer — run by the skill's customer pass (Step 1e-ter). A customer attestation: Spaarke's operator cannot read another tenant's cross-tenant access settings. Skill-local intake field, NOT sent to POST /api/runs.
